description: A black dragon seen in silhouette from the side, flying to the right above the dark spires of a castle or city. Its long neck curls up to a horned head with a small glowing red eye, its tail curls down below its body, and its wide bat-like wings show orange-brown membranes between black ribs. Behind it the sky is a deep royal blue, with large concentric grey rings radiating from behind the dragon like a halo of moonlight. The jagged black towers stand along the bottom edge. The mood is ominous and grand. Frame 1: both wings are raised high above the body. Frame 2: the wings sweep down and outward, spread wide. Frame 3: the wings drive fully down and back, the near wing low. Frame 4: the wings begin rising again. The first frame is held a touch longer and the rest pass steadily, so the loop reads as a strong, regular wingbeat.
title: Dark dragon flying over towers
